commit_validation.method: git ls-remote match against remote HEAD, then git clone + git checkout --detach; .git/HEAD equals the 40-character SHA

included_paths_note: Enumerated after inspecting the tree at the pinned SHA, as required by EXTERNAL_EVALUATION_PLAN.md. flaskr/ contains __init__.py, auth.py, blog.py, db.py, schema.sql, static/style.css and templates/**; tests/ contains conftest.py, data.sql and four test modules.

excluded_paths.reason: Flask framework implementation is outside the tutorial evaluation scope
repository-root tests belong to the Flask framework, not the tutorial
framework documentation is not part of the analyzed service

execution_environment.execution_mode: separate_subagent_actors; deterministic gate invoked via stdio MCP against connector dist build
execution_environment.source_checkout: .external-sources/flask (git clone, detached at pinned SHA; not committed)

scope_size.non_python_in_scope: schema.sql, data.sql, style.css, six Jinja templates, pyproject.toml, README.rst

gold_freeze.authored_by: dedicated gold-annotation subagent reading only the pinned source scope; no connector, detector, or generated-document output was available to it
gold_freeze.human_review: human_review_pending — draft is NOT frozen; extractor and Mode A runs stay blocked until a human reviews and approves the gold annotations
gold_freeze.digest_file: gold-digest.txt (written only after human review approval)
